description: Everything that is wrong with the game today

posted: Cloud City East Platform (Docking Bay)
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Watto's Box, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Death Star II: Throne Room and Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place; these count toward the 60 (total 60).

Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list itself has no Coruscant-set card, but the post's 'Changes' line plans Coruscant cards (Security Precautions, the Imperial Arrest Order / Secret Plans combo and the new Masterful Move combo), so it was written after Coruscant's release.
Posted 'Tatooine Podrace Arena', 'Boonta Eve Podrace', 'Sullust' and 'Endor' dested the Dark printings (Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Endor (Dark)).

Posted 'Darth Vader with Lightsaber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber (the strategy's 'EPP Vader'); 'Boba Fett In Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Short Range Fighters' dested Short-range Fighters; 'Bring Him Beofre Me/Take Your Father's Place' is a spelling slip for the objective.
The 'Changes' line (Lord Vader, the combo card, Security Precautions, the new Masterful Move combo) is a planned update; the list is kept as published.
